--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Pin the (tool, op) pairs a ToolCallWitness sees for inner runCode calls
+---
+## What
+
+The FoundationModelsRouter session asked for this test (Router commit a3110737). The Router uses `ToolCallWitness` to count the file edits and code reads of a root session, so it can hint "give this to an agent". Its default matchers expect inner `runCode` calls to carry the op `APISurface.Entry.journalOp`, which is "<verb> <group>". The Router does not depend on Multitool, so it cannot run this test. Multitool must pin the real strings.
+
+### 1. Dependency bump (required)
+`Package.resolved` pins `foundationmodelsextras` at branch `main`, revision `e219f9c5c72f92d5cc4e2d119f077e8fef98b27f`. That revision does NOT contain `ToolCallWitness`. The witness came in with Extras commit `06adccb` ("a ToolCallWitness on MountSite reports each inner call that ToolContext.mount mounts"), and `a63ddda` (on Extras origin/main) closes that work. `a63ddda` is 12 commits ahead of the pin. `.build/checkouts/FoundationModelsExtras` does not have `a63ddda` either.
+- [ ] Run `swift package update FoundationModelsExtras` so `Package.resolved` points at a revision that contains `a63ddda`. `Package.swift` already tracks `main` (`extrasDependencyName`), so it does not change. Confirm the whole suite still builds after the bump; the bump brings in 12 Extras commits.
+
+### 2. How the op is formed (research, current code)
+- `MultiTool.makeLiveTools(for:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/MultiTool.swift`) gives each `LiveTool` the value `journalOp: entry.journalOp`.
+- `APISurface.Entry.journalOp` (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Surface/APISurface.swift`) is `group.map { "\(descriptor.name) \($0)" }`.
+- `makeAsyncHostFunctions` → `invokeAsync(... journalOp: liveTool.journalOp ...)` → `RunBinding.invoke(_:arguments:journalOp:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Invocation/RunBinding.swift`) calls `context.mount(RunToCompletionInnerTool(wrapped: tool), op: journalOp, as: innerMount)`.
+- In Extras, `ToolContext.mount` makes `runSite.posting(to:sessionSink:op:).witnessingCalls`. Each call then calls `site.witnessStart(ofCallTo: wrapped.name, ...)`, which reports `WitnessedToolCall(tool: tool, op: op ?? tool, ...)`.
+- `RunToCompletionInnerTool.name` is `wrapped.name`, the bare verb. So `tool` is the bare verb (for example "edit"), NOT "files.edit" and NOT the op.
+- `RunBinding` exists only when the outer `runCode` call runs under a `ToolContext`. So the outer `MultiTool` must be mounted on the witnessed `MountSite` through `ToolMounting.makeWrapped(tool:site:configuration: .synchronous)`. A `ToolContext(...)` built directly (as in `WorkLeaseFixtures.swift`) carries no witness. A witness never sees the outer `runCode` call itself.
+
+### 3. Predicted (tool, op) pairs
+| snippet call | tool | op |
+|---|---|---|
+| `tools.files.read` | "read" | "read files" |
+| `tools.files.edit` | "edit" | "edit files" |
+| `tools.code_context.getSymbol` (stub) | "getSymbol" | "getSymbol code_context" |
+
+These match the Router's assumptions for edit, read and getSymbol.
+
+### 4. Mismatches with the Router's assumptions. Report these to the Router session.
+- The Router assumes "search files" (`tools.files.search`). There is NO `search` verb in Multitool's files capability. `FilesCapability` (noun "files") has eight verbs: `read`, `write`, `edit`, `patch`, `glob`, `grep`, `makeDirectory`, `removeDirectory`. "search files" never occurs.
+- The Router's edit set ("edit files", "write files") leaves out "patch files" (`tools.files.patch`, `Patch.swift`, which also changes files) and the directory verbs "makeDirectory files" and "removeDirectory files". The read set leaves out "glob files".
+- Multitool has no built-in `code_context` group. The real strings come from whatever host registers that group (for example an MCP server named `code_context` gives "<toolName> code_context"). The test uses a stub, so it pins the shape and not a real catalog.
+- `WitnessedToolCall.tool` is the bare verb ("edit"). It is not qualified by the group. A Router matcher that keys on `tool` cannot tell `files.read` from another group's `read`. It must key on `op`.
+
+### 5. Test
+New file `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/InnerCallWitnessOpTests.swift`. Model it on `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/RegisteredJournalOpTests.swift` (its suite shape, `TestScratch`, `.ownsTemporaryDirectories`, and the `Self.run(_:over:under:)` pattern) and on the session in Extras `Tests/.../Hosting/ToolCallWitnessTests.swift` (`RecordingWitness`, `MountSite(sessionID:runPlane:sink:inlineSettleGrace:callWitness:)` + `ToolMounting.makeWrapped`). Take the snippet shape from `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/FilesCrossOpFlowTests.swift`, which does a read and then `tools.files.edit({ path, find, replace })`.
+- [ ] Add a `RecordingWitness: ToolCallWitness` that keeps each `WitnessedToolCall` in order under an `OSAllocatedUnfairLock` (the same pattern as `AmbientRecordingTool` in `Fixtures/RunBindingFixtures.swift`), and a no-op `OperationEventSink`. Reuse `LeaseRecordingSink` (`Fixtures/WorkLeaseFixtures.swift`) if it fits.
+- [ ] Build the registry with `MultiTool.Builder().withFiles(root: <scratch dir with one seeded file>).addGroup(named: "code_context", [<stub Tool named "getSymbol">]).buildRegistry()`. The stub can be `AmbientRecordingTool(name: "getSymbol")`.
+- [ ] Make `MountSite(sessionID: ULID(), runPlane: RunPlane(), sink: sink, callWitness: witness)`. Mount `MultiTool(registry:)` with `ToolMounting.makeWrapped(tool:site:configuration: .synchronous)` cast to `any Tool<RunCodeArguments, String>`. Call it once with a snippet that runs `tools.files.read`, then `tools.files.edit`, then `tools.code_context.getSymbol()`.
+- [ ] Assert that `witness.calls.map { ($0.tool, $0.op) }` equals exactly `[("read", "read files"), ("edit", "edit files"), ("getSymbol", "getSymbol code_context")]`, in that order, and that each `sessionID` is the site's session. If the real strings differ from the prediction, pin the REAL strings and write the difference in the task comment.
+- [ ] Add a second assertion that the witness got no entry for the outer `runCode` call: the count is exactly 3.
+
+### Hand-off
+The Router session wants the commit sha once this is on origin/main. Send it, together with every string that differs from the Router's assumptions (section 4, plus any surprise the test finds).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `Package.resolved` pins a FoundationModelsExtras revision that contains `a63ddda`, and `ToolCallWitness` / `MountSite.init(..., callWitness:)` compile from the Multitool test target.
+- [ ] `InnerCallWitnessOpTests` passes and asserts exactly 3 witnessed calls with the (tool, op) pairs `("read","read files")`, `("edit","edit files")`, `("getSymbol","getSymbol code_context")`, or the real strings if they differ, with the difference recorded.
+- [ ] The full test suite passes after the dependency bump.
+- [ ] The task comment records the commit sha and the mismatches for the Router session.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/InnerCallWitnessOpTests.swift`: the new suite described above.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter InnerCallWitnessOpTests` passes.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes in full; the Extras bump must not break the existing suites.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing test first. Before the bump it fails to compile because `ToolCallWitness` is missing. Then bump the dependency and make it pass.
\ No newline at end of file
